payload.body_they: {{Name}} wants to be taken seriously, but public achievement can come at the expense of their private life. A demanding project takes their free time, a leadership role fills their evenings, and work follows them home. The Moon brings the focus back to their physical and emotional baseline. Sleep, meals, privacy, and the routines that anchor them do not lose their value just because people are proud of what they are doing. One extra meeting or one late night can look completely manageable on paper, but added together, they dictate what {{Name}}'s everyday life actually feels like. Their basic needs have to factor into whatever they are building publicly. Recognition is great, but a path forward only makes sense if they can sustain living inside it.
